# Devendra Mulewa

> Software engineer based in India who designs and builds software systems, developer tools, and user experiences for businesses. Currently freelancing on Upwork.

- [Things](https://devendram.com/things.html): Personal experiments, prototypes, and open source projects, User Core, cmdgenie-cli, LLM Judge Harness, Career RAG, Profile RAG, and Tech Shorts, mostly RAG/LLM tooling built with Python, FastAPI, and Ollama.
